note: 수동 큐레이션. 공식 발표·공연장 일정을 확인해 선별 정리한 목록이며 전수 목록이 아니다. 지난 공연은 사이트에서 자동으로 숨겨지므로, 갱신이 늦어도 틀린 정보가 남지는 않는다.

items.title: PLAVE Concert
items.note: PLAVE are a virtual idol group — the members perform live through motion-captured animated avatars, and the show is built around large-screen staging. One of the few K-pop acts you genuinely cannot experience the same way anywhere else.

items.title: The Fact Music Awards
items.note: A stadium-scale awards night with a long performance lineup rather than a single headliner. Awards shows are the easiest way to see many groups in one evening, and they are announced months ahead — useful if you are planning a trip around one.

items.title: OBJET K-POP FESTA
items.note: A two-day multi-artist festival at the KINTEX convention centre, about 40 minutes from central Seoul on Line 3. Festival line-ups are usually revealed in stages, so check the official channels close to the date.

items.title: ILLIT Concert
items.note: INSPIRE Arena sits next to Incheon Airport, which makes it unusually convenient if you are flying in for the show — the resort complex has hotels on site and an airport rail link into Seoul.

items.title: Melon Music Awards
items.note: One of the year's biggest K-pop nights, held over two days at Korea's only domed stadium. Gocheok is inside Seoul on Line 1, so it is the most accessible of the large-venue events for visitors without a car.
